To regression-test the link rendering branch, main agent should seed at least 1 CAPA with linked_entity_type='risk' or 'incident'.

Hazard catalogue: backend returns 13 hazards for trades grouped into 5 categories (Physical, Chemical, Biological, Ergonomic, Psychosocial visible). All include code/name/category/description/typical_consequences/typical_controls/regulation fields.
Hazard cross-industry guard works: trades user GET /api/hazard-library?industry=hospitality → 403; GET /api/hazard-library/burns_steam (hospitality code) → 404 for trades. Good defense-in-depth.
Sidebar items count > 40 — UX scannability concern; consider collapsible sections (Core / Modules / Add-ons / Library). Not blocking ship.
